changelog:
Initial public release of ua1-validator-agent-skill.

- Enables agents to validate PDFs for PDF/UA-1 compliance using ua1.dev APIs.
- Provides health, validation, compact mode, and metrics endpoints.
- Supports deterministic, machine-readable verdicts and structured remediation workflows.
- Includes bash script and CI integration guidance for automated pipelines.
summary: Validate PDFs against PDF/UA-1 using ua1.dev or api.ua1.dev from AI coding agents (OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode). Use when an agent needs deterministic accessibility checks, compact machine-readable verdicts, CI gating, or structured remediation loops for PDF files.
